title: OpenRhen engine plan-and-forecast request, contract version 1
description: Structural schema for the engine wire, generated from the zod schemas. A valid schema is necessary, not sufficient: the server is the authority. It checks shape only; the rules in x-unconverted-rules (and the format keywords, which many validators treat as annotations) are enforced only by the server, so a document can pass this schema and still be refused with validation_failed.

x-unconverted-rules.rule: horizonEnd must be after calculatedAt and at most 366 days (PLAN_FORECAST_MAX_HORIZON_DAYS) after it.
Estimates must be ordered optimisticMinutes <= expectedMinutes <= pessimisticMinutes, and minimumSessionMinutes must not exceed maximumSessionMinutes.

Ids unique per entity kind; recovery window needs both ends and they must differ; outcomes, projects and actions must reference existing parents and dependencies; per-action session range, estimate ordering and recurrence/cadence consistency (cross-reference and cross-field checks).
An end_date recurrence needs an end date, a total_minutes recurrence needs a target, and minimum spacing times target occurrences must fit within a days period.
Weekdays must be listed once each, in ascending order.
A live condition names exactly one of recurrenceRuleId or commitmentId; every other kind names neither.
A time band's start must be before its end.
A span's endDate must not be before its startDate.
A span window must end after it starts (it cannot cross midnight).
